# Data

LOLA was performed for DM, hyper-, and hypomethylated Cgs different conditions using all Cgs of the normalized data set as the universe.

```{r}
all_result_tabs <- list()
```


```{r}
transform_tab <- function(x, study, db , comparison) {
  if(!inherits(x, "data.table")) x <- as.data.table(x)
  x$study <- study
  x$DB <- db
  x$comparison <- comparison
  x$ID = paste0(x$collection, "_", x$description) |> make.unique()
  
  x$OddsRatio <- x$logOddsRatio
  x$logOddsRatio <- log2(x$OddsRatio)

  x$untreated = with(x, !complete.cases(treatment) | treatment == "None" | treatment == "No treatment" | treatment == "regular medium" | treatment == "serum_starved_media" | treatment == "serum_stimulated_media" | treatment == "full media" | treatment == "mock" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RAR _A704)" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RXR _sc774)" )

  x$comp_direction <- ifelse(grepl("_hyper$",comparison), "Hyper", ifelse(grepl("_hypo$", comparison), "Hypo", "other") )

  x$comp_ID <- paste0(x$study, "__", x$comparison)
  x$collection_ID <- paste0(x$DB, "__", x$collection)
  
  x[, pos_rank := rank(ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, -logOddsRatio, NA)), by="collection_ID"]
  x[, neg_rank := rank(ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, logOddsRatio, NA)), by="collection_ID"]
  x[["qValue"]] <- NULL
  return(x)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=20}
for(comp_dir in c("Hyper","Hypo")) {
  for (sc in sel_collections) {
    tmp <- subset(all_results_final, p.adj < 0.2 & 
                     (pos_rank < 20 | neg_rank < 20) &
                     comp_direction == comp_dir & 
                     comp_ID %in% sel_comparisons & 
                     collection_ID == sc)
    if(nrow(tmp) < 1) next

    df <- reshape2::dcast(tmp, collection_ID + DB + collection + label ~ comp_ID, value.var = "logOddsRatio", fun.aggregate = mean)
    df$sig_cnt <- rowSums(as.matrix(!is.na(df[, 5:ncol(df)])))
    
    #tmp <- subset(df, collection_ID == sc & comp_direction == comp_dir & sig_cnt > 1)
    if(nrow(df) < 1) next
    m <- df[, 5:(ncol(df)-1)] |> as.matrix()
    rownames(m) <- df$label
    m[is.infinite(m)] <- sign(m[is.infinite(m)]) * 20
    m2 <- m
    m2[is.na(m2)] <- 0
    row_hclust <- hclust(dist(m2), method="mcquitty")
    col_hclust <- hclust(dist(t(m2)), method="mcquitty")
    breaks <- c(-20,-10,-5,seq(-2,2,by=4/94),5,10,20)
    pheatmap(m, main=paste0(sc, "- ", comp_dir), cluster_cols=col_hclust, cluster_rows = row_hclust, breaks=breaks)
  }
}
```

```{r}
capwords <- function(s, strict = FALSE) {
    cap <- function(s) paste(toupper(substring(s, 1, 1)),
                  {s <- substring(s, 2); if(strict) tolower(s) else s},
                             sep = "", collapse = " " )
    sapply(strsplit(s, split = " "), cap, USE.NAMES = !is.null(names(s)))
}
```

for(comp_dir in c("Hyper","Hypo")) {
  # for (sc in sel_collections) {
    tmp <- subset(all_results_final_combined_filtered, #p.adj < 0.05 & 
#                     (min_pos_rank < 10 | min_neg_rank < 10) &
                     comp_direction == comp_dir & 
                     comp_ID %in% sel_comparisons & 
                     # collection_ID == sc & 
                    untreated )
    if(nrow(tmp) < 1) next

    tmp[ ,sig_cnt:=.N, by="label"]
    # Show only entries significant in at least two comparisons
    tmp <- subset(tmp, sig_cnt >= 2)
    
    tmp[, median_logOR:=median(logOddsRatio), by="label"]
    #tmp[, median_logOR_this_study:=median(logOddsRatio, na.rm=T), by="label"]
    
    #tmp2 <- tmp[study_type=="This study" & p.adj < 0.05]
    tmp2 <- tmp[p.adj < 0.05]
    tmp2[, median_logOR_esgi:=median(logOddsRatio), by="label"]
    labels_ordered <- tmp2[order(tmp2$median_logOR_esgi, decreasing = T), ]$label |> unique()
    
    tmp <- subset(tmp, label %in% labels_ordered)
    
    tmp$label <- factor(tmp$label, levels=labels_ordered)
    
    tmp$significant = ifelse(tmp$p.adj < 0.05, "FDR<5%","n.s.")
    
    p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x=label, y = logOddsRatio)) + 
      geom_point(aes(col=significant, shape=target_group_type), size = 2) + 
#      stat_summary(size=0.5) + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
            plot.margin=unit(c(.2,.2,.2,2), 'cm'), 
            strip.text.y = element_text(size=6)) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept=0, col="red") + 
      scale_color_manual(values=c("FDR<5%"="red3","n.s."="gray70")) +
      facet_grid(study_type2 ~ collection_ID_2, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
      ggtitle(paste0("Enrichment in ", comp_dir,"methylated CpGs")) + 
      labs(x="",y="Enrichment Log Odds Ratio") + 
      guides(col = guide_legend(title = "Significance"),
             shape = guide_legend(title="Cell type")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=1:20)
    
    print(p)
    
    pdf(file.path(result_folder, paste0("LOLA_Enrichment_in_", comp_dir,"methylated_CpGs.pdf")), width=12, height = 4.5)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
    
  # }
